records.query: SELECT source_id,designation,ref_epoch,ra,dec,ra_error,dec_error,pmra,pmdec,pmra_error,pmdec_error,astrometric_params_solved,phot_g_mean_mag,ruwe,duplicated_source,visibility_periods_used FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',41.37358333333333,-53.037325,0.4)) ORDER BY source_id
